message:
## Vulnerability Digest

No new vulnerabilities credibly matching the monitored product list were reported in the last 24 hours. The review window was 2026-08-11 23:40 UTC through 2026-08-12 23:40 UTC (2026-08-12 05:10 IST through 2026-08-13 05:10 IST).

No findings passed all freshness, product-match, and source-credibility checks. MongoDB Server, mongod, mongos, Atlas, Ops Manager, drivers, connectors, and other major official components were included in the search and produced no verified in-scope disclosure.

Recent reporting on Microsoft's August security release and Fortinet vulnerabilities referred to disclosures before this window and was excluded to avoid repeating stale findings. A newly highlighted Cisco issue affected ASA/FTD rather than the monitored Nexus, UCS, or Fabric Extender products and was excluded as a product mismatch.

No immediate review is recommended based solely on new disclosures in this window; continue normal patch and vulnerability-management monitoring.
